explorer.context, for a table
  Select Top 1000 Ro&ws
  ---
  &Script Table as >
    &CREATE To >
      &New Query Editor Window
      &File…
      C&lipboard
    &ALTER To > (disabled)
      &New Query Editor Window (disabled)
      &File… (disabled)
      C&lipboard (disabled)
    C&REATE OR ALTER To > (disabled)
      &New Query Editor Window (disabled)
      &File… (disabled)
      C&lipboard (disabled)
    &DROP To >
      &New Query Editor Window
      &File…
      C&lipboard
    DROP A&nd CREATE To >
      &New Query Editor Window
      &File…
      C&lipboard
    ---
    &SELECT To >
      &New Query Editor Window
      &File…
      C&lipboard
    &INSERT To >
      &New Query Editor Window
      &File…
      C&lipboard
    &UPDATE To >
      &New Query Editor Window
      &File…
      C&lipboard
    D&ELETE To >
      &New Query Editor Window
      &File…
      C&lipboard
    ---
    E&XECUTE To > (disabled)
      &New Query Editor Window (disabled)
      &File… (disabled)
      C&lipboard (disabled)
  ---
  Copy &Name
  ---
  Re&fresh
